purpose: Synthetic, model-on-model identifiability analysis. NO human measured accuracy and NO dose advice.
prior_source_identity: P2-O previously exposed Price1997/Rosano1997 constrained candidate grid; no Doll anchor

synthetic_latent_concentration.units_warning: Artificial dimensioned numbers only, NOT observed in any paper, person or app

error_scale_rule: sigma_i=sqrt(sigma_abs^2+(sigma_prop*truth_i)^2), frozen to synthetic truth. Profile b>=0, A>=0 with weighted least squares; mismatch is NOT likelihood or calibrated chi-square.

dual_slow_input.source: P2-O accepted75 with slow effective weight >0

synthetic_family_benchmark.heuristic_complexity_penalty: Train SSE + (shape_dim-2)*ln(n_training_points); for comparison only, NOT true AIC/BIC/Bayes factor, and candidate grids were hand-selected after data exposure
synthetic_family_benchmark.test_metric: Mean squared error against synthetic latent (noise-free) holdout, weighted by synthetic fixed truth sigma; neither clinical external validation nor CV on real humans

exact_nonidentifiabilities: Bioavailability F and apparent volume V only enter as F/V without IV dose or other constraints
At slow_weight=0, slow input rate k_slow drops out exactly
If sampled at only two times and gain/baseline both free, distinct shapes can interpolate two values wherever positive fit exists
